probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) A regenerative braking control system for an __electrically powered vehicle__, comprising: at least one sensor adapted to sense a front tire impact event and transmit a sensor signal responsive to the front tire impact event during vehicle braking; and a regenerative powertrain interfacing with the at least one sensor and adapted to reduce regenerative braking torque responsive to receiving the sensor signal from the at least one sensor.

4. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1 further comprising an electrical storage facility interfacing with and adapted to store electrical power from the regenerative powertrain, wherein the electrical storage facility is a battery.

5. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1 wherein the regenerative powertrain is adapted to apply regenerative braking torque to at least one of a front axle and a rear axle of the vehicle, wherein the regenerative braking torque is applied to at least one of the front wheels and the rear wheels of the vehicle.

9. (Currently Amended) A regenerative braking control system for an __electrically powered vehicle__, comprising: at least one of a wheel slip sensor and a vehicle motion sensor adapted to sense a front tire impact event and transmit at least one of a wheel slip sensor signal and a motion sensor signal, respectively, responsive to the front tire impact event during vehicle braking; and a regenerative powertrain interfacing with the at least one sensor and adapted to reduce regenerative braking torque responsive to receiving the at least one of a wheel slip sensor signal and a motion sensor signal from the at least one of a wheel slip sensor and a vehicle motion sensor.
